draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.98, the 141st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 17th of 34 at DE. He went 135th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Deatrich Wise. Testing standouts: three-cone (80th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (85th percentile). Testing concerns: broad jump (16th percentile). College production: 8 sacks in 2020, 10th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 36 career games and 4 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 4 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2024.
